vacuum_policy: cleaning=start; idle=return_to_base/stop fallback; capability-gated; physical experiments blocked
manual_feedback: Wrong decision keeps the existing immediate correction path unchanged. Historical Teach is a separate supervised RL rebuild workflow.
manual_feedback_ui: Four actions: Shadow/Control, Wrong decision, Settings, Teach. Historical Teach defaults to a 10-minute chart and uses an explicit Train RL action.
manual_feedback_context: Wrong decision keeps its existing context-learning behavior. Teach RL independently re-screens the broad eligible HA context against active historical labels.
manual_feedback_schema: Teach RL can replace occupied context slots when a supervised hidden feature is stronger, then runs the normal offline rebuild on the selected schema.
manual_feedback_safety: Wrong decision and Executor guards are unchanged. Teach stores historical training data and never sends a device service directly.
desired_teaching: Historical Teach points are persistent supervised RL examples; they do not provide a runtime override or immediate device action.
agent_rendering: event-time renderer dispatch; stable card ownership by normalized agent ID
button_teaching: Dedicated Teach RL label log, bounded Recorder context refresh, full-context candidate scoring, offline rebuild and supervised LinUCB fine-tuning; Wrong decision remains on the legacy teaching endpoint.
teaching_history: Teach RL defaults to 600 seconds; replay is bounded, uses the base RL policy and redraws after retraining; gray translucent drag selection is visible on dark charts.
teach_rl: labels -> bounded Recorder context -> feature reselection -> deterministic rebuild -> supervised LinUCB -> replay
teach_rl_feature_reselection: full eligible context after Recorder refresh; strong supervised features can replace occupied context slots
teach_rl_queue: context preflight waits for the shared heavy-job gate and completes before HistoryManager starts the destructive rebuild
wrong_decision: unchanged existing immediate contextual/manual correction path
sensor_tournament: persistent candidate -> challenger -> future-only prequential validation -> promotion -> probation/rollback
sensor_tournament_promotion: 40+ future samples, 3+ observed days, >=3pp cumulative gain, three consecutive 24h winning windows, 24h cooldown
sensor_tournament_primary_protection: primary replacement requires >7pp gain unless global margin is stricter
sensor_tournament_quality: predictive gain is reliability-adjusted; unavailable sensors are penalized
sensor_tournament_requalification: schema promotion demotes affected Control agent to Shadow and requires fresh qualification
sensor_tournament_probation: previous serialized model/schema preserved; >3pp degradation after minimum paired evidence rolls back automatically
sensor_tournament_simulator: A: new 90% sensor beats 75% champion and promotes; B: 300 tiny-sample noise sensors cannot promote; C: concept drift automatically replaces A with B
fast_light_baseline: current enabled Home Assistant automation first; extra raw sensors enter through Sensor Tournament
fast_light_objective: automation-residual timing in Shadow: confirmed earlier ON and safe earlier OFF are rewarded
fast_light_negative_outcomes: false early ON, premature OFF, false early OFF and quick OFF-to-ON retrigger are penalized
fast_light_tournament_metric: paired normalized timing utility for fast binary power agents; balanced accuracy retained as safety guardrail
fast_light_tournament_safety: block promotion above 10% challenger timing failures or >3pp balanced-accuracy degradation
fast_light_timing_persistence: additive fast_light_timing_metrics table; no existing user tables cleared
migration: additive SQLite only; agents, archive history, Teach labels, feedback, models, benchmarks and existing Tournament state preserved
anticipation_simulator: Production anticipation, dispatch and reward simulator passes together with dedicated confidence-gate tests
fast_light_timing_simulator: automation-relative ON lead/OFF saved-time rewards plus false/premature penalties and timing-aware Tournament gain
